practice.instruction: Use operations to isolate the target variable.
practice.chooseMode: Choose a mode and apply a transformation.

validation.noValidTransformation: No valid transformation found for this equation. Check your calculation.
validation.cannotParse: Could not parse equation. Use format: expression = expression
validation.cannotParseTerm: Could not parse the term. Use format like 3x, y, or 5.
validation.cannotApply: This operation cannot be applied here. The expression may not change.

move_term.label: Move Term
move_term.desc: Move a term to the other side of the equation.

add_both.label: Add
add_both.desc: Add the same value to both sides of the equation.
add_both.hint_gather: Add {param} to both sides to gather variables

sub_both.label: Subtract
sub_both.desc: Subtract the same value from both sides of the equation.
sub_both.hint_gather: Subtract {param} from both sides to gather variables

mul_both.label: Multiply
mul_both.desc: Multiply both sides by the same value.

div_both.label: Divide
div_both.desc: Divide both sides by the same non-zero value.

collect.label: Combine like terms
collect.desc: Combine like terms into a simpler expression.

isolate.label: Isolate
isolate.desc: Isolate the variable if it has a coefficient of 1.
isolate.hint_gather: Move all terms with {param} to one side using the Isolate operation
isolate.hint_gentle: Look for a way to isolate {param}
